content: Brazilian streetwear brand sites (owlshit.store, brzcoast.com.br, realgrapixo.com.br, hardvision.com.br, ofstreet.com.br, bronkybrand.com, yungstreet.com.br): WhatsApp contact is universal (header contact block, contact page, wa.me links; Ciena puts it in header marquee); Instagram is the primary social link everywhere; about pages (Quem somos / Sobre Nos) tell place-rooted brand stories; schema.org Organization JSON-LD with sameAs socials is standard; announcement bars with promos (frete gratis, liquida, PIX discount) are common.
